name: @pipeworx/mcp-fragile-states-index

tools.name: fsi_country_score
tools.description: Fragile States Index score and rank for ONE country — a country-fragility risk measure (12 cohesion/economic/political/social indicators rolled into one 0-120 score; higher = more fragile). Published annually by The Fund for Peace. PREFER for "how fragile is <country>", "<country> fragile states index", "state fragility risk for <country>", or as background context on a country before/alongside news-event data (complements gdelt). Pass a country name (e.g. "Somalia", "Brazil", "United States" — common aliases like "USA"/"DRC"/"Ivory Coast" are accepted).

tools.name: fsi_ranking
tools.description: Rank countries by Fragile States Index score — the N most fragile or N most stable countries in one call, with rank and score. PREFER for "most fragile countries", "most stable/least fragile countries", "top 10 failed states", "which countries are at highest state-fragility risk". direction defaults to "most_fragile".

limit.description: How many countries to return (default 10, max 50).

direction.description: Which end of the ranking to return. Default "most_fragile".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-fragile-states-index forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the fragile-states-index pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
